scripts.worker:cpu:watch: trap 'exit 0' INT TERM; until WORKER_ROLE=cpu tsx --env-file=.env worker/index.ts; do echo '[worker:cpu:watch] worker exited non-zero, restarting in 1s'; sleep 1; done
scripts.worker:io:watch: trap 'exit 0' INT TERM; until WORKER_ROLE=io tsx --env-file=.env worker/index.ts; do echo '[worker:io:watch] worker exited non-zero, restarting in 1s'; sleep 1; done
scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U workflow -d workflow_lab -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-schema.sql
